blocks.text: MANILA – A low-pressure area (LPA) outside the country could enter the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) this week and potentially intensify into a typhoon by the weekend. “It could possibly develop into a tropical depression by Wednesday and likely reach the typhoon category during the weekend,” Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) Administrator Nathaniel Servando told the Philippine News Agency. The LPA was last located 1,960 kilometers east of Eastern Visayas.
